notablePrerequisites:
Mercurial Pretender on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Mercurial Pretender do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Mercurial Pretender.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Mercurial Pretender.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
